condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: With UNICEF support, 3,945 non-readers (50 per cent female) in Azraq and Za’atari camps are learning to read. UNICEF also enhanced education quality by improving teaching practices of 296 teachers and supervisors (49 per cent female) through a professional development course accredited by the MOE. Efforts to enhance student learning and teacher development are designed with an equity focus, ensuring that learning outcomes are gender-equitable and inclusive.
